```{r}
#| label: cvevents
cvevents <- function(tbl, when, what, where, descr) {

    command_start <- "\\cvevent"
    tbl[[where]] <- gsub("\n", " \\\\newline ", tbl[[where]])
    # Multi-line descriptions become LaTeX itemize lists; single lines stay inline
    is_list <- grepl("\n", tbl[[descr]])
    tbl[[descr]] <- ifelse(
        is_list,
        paste0(
            "\\begin{itemize}[itemsep=1pt, parsep=0pt, topsep=2pt, leftmargin=1.2em]\n",
            gsub("\n", "\n  \\\\item ", paste0("\\item ", tbl[[descr]])),
            "\n\\end{itemize}"
        ),
        tbl[[descr]]
    )
    res <- paste0(
        command_start, "{", tbl[[when]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[where]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[descr]], "}"
        )

    cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}

cvproj <- function(tbl,what,role,items){
    command_start <- "\\cvproj"
    res <- paste0(
        command_start, "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
        "{", tbl[[role]], "}",
        "{", sapply(tbl[[items]], function(x)paste0(x,collapse = ", ")), "}"
    )

    cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}
```

# Summary

Data analyst and social policy researcher working with quantitative data on welfare, poverty, markets and public services in Iran since 2018. I collect, clean, validate and analyse datasets from surveys, administrative records and national statistics, and turn them into dashboards, reports and data stories for decision-makers. This includes leading a data literacy course for NGOs and organising a project-based workshop on Household Income and Expenditure Survey data. Skilled in R (tidyverse, data.table), Python, SQL and advanced Excel, with dashboards in R or with other tools. I hold an MA in Social Policy from Allameh Tabataba'i University and teach data literacy, data management and applied AI to analysts, journalists and organisational staff. Fluent in Persian and English.
